source:
@@U02403@@
Boasting becomes you; but now let’s see some of your arts.

@@U02405@@
Watch! I snap my fingers and already the chariot glitters brightly! Look! A string of pearls leaps out!

@@U02406@@
(He continues snapping his fingers all about.)

@@U02407@@
You see? Golden clasps for neck or ear! Combs, coronets, rings set with priceless jewels! Now and again I dispense a spark of flame, hoping to see it catch somewhere.

@@U02409@@
Look at them! Snatching and grabbing for treasure! The poor boy’s nearly in danger of them! The way he throws gems, you'd think it was a dream, and everyone in the whole hall snatching! Ah, but here come new tricks! No matter what one seizes, it’s a pale reward: it flutters off and he’s empty-handed. Strings of pearls dissolve into so many beetles; they throw them off and they buzz around their heads, the poor dunces! Others, instead of a solid handful, find all they've grasped is frivolous butterflies.
translation:
@@U02403@@
夸口就成了你；但现在让我们来看看你的一些艺术作品。

@@U02405@@
观看！我打了个响指，战车已经闪闪发光了！看！一串珍珠跃出！

@@U02406@@
（他继续打响指。）

@@U02407@@
你看到了吗？颈部或耳朵的金色扣环！梳子、皇冠、戒指都镶嵌着无价的珠宝！我时不时地发出一点火焰，希望看到它在某个地方燃起。

@@U02409@@
看看他们！抢夺宝藏！这个可怜的男孩几乎面临着他们的危险！他扔宝石的样子，你以为是在做梦，整个大厅里的人都在抢！啊，但是新花样来了！无论抓住什么，这都是苍白的奖励：它飘走了，他两手空空。一串串珍珠溶化成无数甲虫；他们把它们扔掉，它们在他们的头上嗡嗡作响，可怜的笨蛋！另一些人则发现自己抓到的不是一把坚实的蝴蝶，而是一些轻浮的蝴蝶。
